My dear [Christabel](../persons.html#329)
I think if you told [Warne ](../persons.html#1433)that you had had an offer from [Smith and Elder](../others.html#238) he would be sure to take your story.

The stupid man has just refused Florence Wilford’s dominie and ought to be scarified.[^1] I shall have [Joanna ](../persons.html#1154)and [Fanny Patteson](../persons.html#1154) with me on the 20th, and it is also the time of one of the [lectures](../others.html#240), so it will depend on a good many things whether I shall have the pleasant sight of you.
your affectionate

C M Yonge

[^1]: Florence Wilford, Dominie Freylinghausen (London, Mozley 1875).

It ran as a serial in MP ns 13 (January-June 1872).
